### AI Prompt for Dynamic Email Sequence Generation

**Objective:**  
Generate the first email of a three-step cold email nurturing sequence for Summit Roofing. Emails should reflect the direct, engaging, and slightly humorous tone of Jason Nemes, emphasizing value-driven messaging while addressing common objections and concerns.

**Instructions for AI:**  
1. Personalize each email based on the recipient's name{{$6.firstName}} and their interest in roofing services {{$6.keyword}}.
  
2. Structure each email using:
  
{{$6.emailHeader1}} (e.g., "Email 1/3")  
{{$6.emailSubject1}} (Engaging, personalized subject line)  
{{$6.emailSalutation1}} (Friendly greeting) 
{{$6.emailBody1}}(Introduction, problem awareness, solution)  
{{$6.emailCTA1}} (Clear and actionable call-to-action)  
{{$6.emailClose1}} (Warm closing statement)  
{{$6.emailSignature1}} (Name and title)  
{{$6.emailFooter1}} (Contact details & disclaimer)  

Store each resulting section of the email in the appropriate variable.

**Email 1/3:**  
- **Tone:** Friendly introduction, build rapport, emphasize Summit Roofing’s expertise in insurance claims.  
- **CTA:** Schedule a free inspection.  

The response must be in JSON format, following this structure:
```json
{
"emailHeader1": "Follow-up on Your Interest in Our Services",
"emailSubject1": "Still Interested? Let’s Connect!",
"emailSalutation1": "Dear {{$1.body.Firstname}},",
"emailBody1": "I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to follow up on our previous conversation regarding [service/product]. We would love the opportunity to discuss how we can assist you in achieving your goals. Let me know if you’d be available for a quick chat this week.",
"emailCTA1": "Please reply to this email or book a time that works for you using [calendar link].",
"emailClose1": "Looking forward to your response.",
"emailSignature1": "Best regards,\n[Your Name]\n[Your Position]\n[Your Company]",
"emailFooter1": "If you have any questions, feel free to reach out. We’re happy to help!"
"emailSent1": Entire response
}
"
```
Ensure the response is formatted strictly as JSON, with no additional text outside the structured data."

Ensure emails feel conversational and natural, avoiding a generic template feel. 

Store entire result as a variable: "emailSent1"

default.string: Hello! Let's talk about the following: {query}

params.title: Dialogue History JSON
Temperature
params.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. We generally recommend altering this or "Top P" but not both.

params.title: Max Tokens
params.description:
Integer between 1 and 8192. The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.
The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model's context length.

params.title: Stop
params.description: Up to 16 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

params.title: Presence Penalty
params.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

params.title: Frequency Penalty
params.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

params.title: Top P
params.description: Number between 0 and 1. An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with "Top P" probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or "Temperature" but not both.

params.title: Response Format
params.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output. To enable JSON mode, also mention it in the prompt. Example: 'Make a list in JSON format'.
